verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs say you can send stablecoins from a BVNK account (bvnk-docs-13, bvnk-docs-18) and route funds to blockchain addresses programmatically via the `POST /payment/v1/rules` on-ramp API (bvnk-docs-5, bvnk-docs-14). Generic webhooks (bvnk-docs-2) and a sandbox that simulates payouts (bvnk-docs-3) support integration, but the evidence never shows a dedicated crypto payout endpoint, stored-recipient support, or a payout status lifecycle through to settlement. Missing for 10: an explicit stablecoin payout API endpoint, payouts to stored/saved recipients, documented payout status states and settlement-tracking webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
